messages:
Samira V: Quick raw capture from this morning's SprintLight onboarding call — pasting notes for CS -> Product triage. Flagging anything with renewal language.

Noah L: paste away. any immediate churn risk?

Samira V: Four asks and a few pain quotes: 
- Freshness: after a 30k doc sync they reported new docs not searchable for ~5 hours. Quote: "We had to cancel an external demo because the updates never showed up."
- Relevance stability: results for the same query change across sessions; they suspect model variant routing.
- Billing controls: want per-project soft caps + alerting emails and a webhook to their billing admin.
- Import reliability: during bulk import ~1.5% of items returned 502/timeout and the UI showed them as "imported" which confused their ops team.

Ravi S: Routing suggestion: Freshness + stability -> infra/serving and product-ml (evals). Billing -> pricing & product. Import reliability -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Prioritization note: mark freshness and relevance as P1 (demo/exec impact). Billing + import retries P2. Recommend adding "renewal_watch" tag since customer said they'd consider other vendors if this persists.

Noah L: Can we get repro artifacts? timestamps of upload, sample failing queries, request ids, and any dashboard screenshots.

Samira V: Customer timings: upload_start=2026-08-03T10:05:12Z, ingest_done=2026-08-03T10:05:29Z, first observed in search=2026-08-03T15:24:01Z. They attached the CSV and a short query set; I'll add to the ticket.

ops-bot: Created CS-5721: SprintLight indexing freshness + import anomalies (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5721)

Ravi S: Quick log snippet customer pasted:
```
2026-08-03T10:05:12Z start upload job=sl_sync_30k user=sl_eng
2026-08-03T10:05:29Z ingest complete job=sl_sync_30k shards=20
2026-08-03T10:05:30Z kv-cache-invalidate queued key=idx/sprintlight/30k
2026-08-03T10:05:31Z route->variant select variant=v2 delay=120ms
2026-08-03T10:05:33Z write->index queue=write-buffer delayed
2026-08-03T10:06:02Z 502 upstream read_timeout id=up_77a
2026-08-03T15:24:01Z query id=q_119 returned=7
```

Priya: Suggestion for triage: label CS-5721 with weights: renewal_risk=3, demo_impact=2, eng_effort=2, customer_effort=1. Present at Friday product sync.

Samira V: I'll attach the CSV, query set, and the customer's quote to CS-5721. Also updating the account playbook: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

Noah L: Action items: Noah -> upload screenshots + curl repro to ticket (by EOD); Ravi -> request ingest/kv traces from infra (tomorrow AM); Priya -> include prioritization in sync.

Ravi S: I'll also run a staging 30k import to try reproduce the 502s and timing.

Samira V: Customer follow-up language: "If indexing and stability issues aren't resolved before our pilot closure we'll need to pause and evaluate options." Noted. I'll send an acknowledgement and ETA.

Noah L: Thanks all — keeping this high touch. :thumbsup:
